title: Fixed bilingual content, hotspot and cross-page quality suite
description: Six cases, three production-agent stages each. Four text briefs plus two language views of one original synthetic image. Replay outputs are contributor-authored controlled data, not real model quality evidence.
limitations: No real model quality score until source-anchored human review of a live run.
One simple synthetic image does not measure natural-image generalization.
Fixed labels deliberately block missing branches; no unrelated fallback.
The sample is a small regression set, not a statistical model ranking.
